additionalRules: A Grief of Éomer Army must always contain Éomer, who is always the Army's General.
Rohan Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of a Rohan Hero.
Gondor Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of a Gondor Hero.

specialRules.name: Éomer's Wrath
specialRules.text: Éomer is always treated as being under the effects of his The Price of Grief special rule. Additionally, Éomer gains a bonus of +1 to his Fight Value on a turn in which he Charges.

specialRules.name: Fear no enemy
specialRules.text: Éomer gains the Fearless special rule. Additionally, friendly Rohan models that can draw Line of Sight to Éomer automatically pass any Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Ride of Dol Amroth
specialRules.text: Friendly Gondor models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes in a turn in which they Charged.

specialRules.name: Guthwine
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Additionally, each time a model armed with Gúthwinë rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, they may immediately make a single additional To Wound Roll against the same target. If this additional To Wound Roll is a natural 6, this will not benefit from this special rule.

specialRules.name: The Price of Grief
specialRules.text: If Théoden or Éowyn are in the same Army as Éomer, and either (or both) are removed as a casualty, then for the remainder of the game Éomer must re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes. Additionally, for the remainder of the game, when Éomer Moves he must Charge an enemy model if possible.

units.name: Prince Imrahil
units.keywords: MAN, GONDOR, DOL AMROTH, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: The Lineage of Numenor
specialRules.text: The range of Prince Imrahil's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Dol Amroth for Gondor!
specialRules.text: Other friendly Dol Amroth models treat Prince Imrahil as a banner with a range of 6".

units.name: Hurin the Tall, Warden of the Keys

specialRules.name: The Warden's Sword
specialRules.text: This is a Master-forged hand-and-a-half weapon.

specialRules.name: In Defence of the King
specialRules.text: Whilst he is within 3" of your General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword, Húrin automatically passes any Courage Tests he is required to take and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Lines of Command
specialRules.text: Whilst Húrin is alive and on the battlefield, your opponent cannot score any Victory Points for Wounding or slaying the enemy General, so long as your General has the Gondor Keyword.
